card.name: Words before surgery or lasting-damage terms
card.fires_on: Modifier or linking words that come just before a serious lasting outcome, such as surgery, malignancy, failure or fistula. Seen in warnings and contraindications, e.g. 'previous', 'prior', 'secondary', 'acquired', 'such as'.

modes.description: An adjective like secondary, acquired, ovarian or previous that sits right before a disease or procedure term.
